reviews.title: Best 4090 out there.
reviews.comment: I am going to to use two of these in my Lian Li Case (Using one so far). They Fit and that means we have a personal rendering farm at our fingertips.  Thank you MSI, my Blender renderers will appreciate it. Now if I can only make enough money for the electric bill each month! Do I have to say they run VERY cool and perform WAY faster than their 3090 brethren ... didn't think so!
reviews.author: Strategic Gamer

reviews.title: Runs like a beast and cool like the winter
reviews.comment: I do a lot of rendering on blender as I make animations and it sped up my rendering time by a massive margin, I use to run a Radeon RX 7900 XTX which was good but nothing compared to the 4090 and temps hit a max of 40c for me when rendering or gaming. Best investment to my system yet.

reviews.title: So far it's a steaming pile of garbage...
reviews.comment:
I've installed the newest and near newest of the drivers with clean Nvidia installs, tried several forums, and even asked MSI themselves for assistance.
MSI started with recommending I re-install windows, so don't expect any help from them gents.
The thing might run a game if you can get it there without plugging a monitor into the gpu till the game is running.  If you try running it with windows, you better not have a monitor plugged in or you'll blue screen over and over till you start crying.  I'm surprised because I thought MSI put out quality products.  I guess I'm finding out otherwise. One more week of seeing if MSI or Nvidia have any suggestions to fix it, but if not, this review will stay, and I'll be putting MSI on my don't buy from list.
